validation.guest_probe_modes_verified: Actual QEMU HDA ABI/playback/capture/mapped lifetime/control metadata and permission DAC verified at the listed run boundaries; complete ioctl/errno matrix and finite-stream EOF remain open.
validation.upstream_alsa_scope: Standard playback/capture, concurrent dmix/dsnoop, speaker-test, controls and repeated raw-null/raw-file lifecycles passed in R10 ds125-127; all 2883584 known capture frames matched. Complete native finite output failed in every completed case. R9 ds124 scene/load600 recovered from two XRUNs; R10 WAV120 diagnostic had zero XRUNs but finite EOF failed and capture was not_run. R6 ds100 remains a counterexample; controls strict duration remains open. U6 not accepted.

common.usercopy: Known commands validate input/output/nested buffers and return EFAULT; unsupported-command precedence is stated per row
common.dac: Owner/group/other DAC at open; capture permission independently tested
common.multicard: N=0..31 M=0..7; sparse live capability-derived nodes, generation-token card isolation; absent direction has no node
common.disconnect: Hardware operations return ENODEV and poll ERR/HUP; protocol/state snapshots can remain readable; fd/VMA hold backing through final reference
common.mmap: ALSA MAP_SHARED data at 0; native OLD/NEW status/control offsets; status READ only, control READ|WRITE, playback DATA WRITE and capture DATA READ required; no EXEC; no HW_FREE/HW_PARAMS while DATA held
common.io_units: read/write bytes; READI/WRITEI/REWIND/FORWARD frames; pointer and queue arithmetic use actual hardware frame progress
common.oss_backend_scope: The OSS rows below describe registered-card PCM. ABI-v1 AC97/ES1371 uses an exclusive backend-generation lease with stereo S16_LE playback and GETCAPS=0; capture, RESET, hardware pointer queries and disabling output trigger are unsupported. Native v1 registration does not create an ALSA card. AC97 guest write/SYNC passed, continuous waveform quality is not accepted.
